debug.title: Debug Tools
debug.open_hint: Open the debug tools page (UUID repair, quest script tools, diagnostics)
debug.page_desc: Diagnostic and repair tools for development and troubleshooting. Actions marked as destructive modify the database.
debug.drift.title: UUID Drift Consolidation
debug.drift.desc: Finds actors whose events and memories are split across multiple UUIDs and merges them onto the correct UUID. Flow: Detect, then Dry Run, review, then Execute Fix.
debug.drift.none: No UUID drift detected. All actors have consistent UUID mappings.
debug.drift.found: UUID drift detected. Run a dry run to preview the fix.
debug.drift.confirm: This will modify the database: drifted UUIDs will be merged onto the correct UUID for each affected actor. Make sure you have reviewed the dry-run results first. Continue?
debug.migration.title: Full UUID Migration
debug.migration.desc: Recalculates ALL UUIDs with the current algorithm and updates events, memories, and mappings to match.
debug.migration.warning: Advanced: only needed if the UUID calculation algorithm changed. This is different from drift consolidation, which only fixes duplicates and drift.
debug.migration.confirm: This recalculates and updates ALL UUIDs in the database: every mapping is checked against the current algorithm, and events, memories, and mappings are rewritten. Caches are cleared and reloaded. Only needed after a UUID algorithm change. Continue?
debug.migration.done: Full UUID migration completed. All UUIDs recalculated and updated.
debug.report.dry_title: Dry run results. No changes were made.
debug.report.dry_note: This was a dry run. No changes were made to the database.
debug.screenshot.title: Screenshot Capture & Vision Test
debug.screenshot.desc: Captures the Skyrim game window (even unfocused) and optionally runs the vision model on the result. Useful for verifying vision provider configuration.
debug.screenshot.resolution_hint: Larger images use more API credits and take longer to process.
debug.screenshot.prompt_placeholder: Leave empty for the default description prompt
debug.template.title: Template Decorator Tester
debug.template.desc: Renders the web/test_decorators_render prompt to exercise all template decorators and verify their output.
debug.quest_inspector.title: Quest Script Inspector
debug.quest_inspector.desc: Discovers the scripts bound to a quest and lists every property and function they expose.
debug.quest_property.title: Quest Property Reader
debug.quest_property.desc: Reads a property value from a quest script and shows it as a string.
debug.quest_function.title: Quest Function Executor
debug.quest_function.desc: Executes a quest script function with typed arguments (string, int, float, bool).
debug.quest.required_quest: Enter a Quest Editor ID first
debug.quest.required_script: Quest Editor ID and Script Name are required
debug.quest.required_func: Quest Editor ID, Script Name, and Function Name are required
debug.crash.title: SEH Stack Trace Test
debug.crash.desc: Tests SEH exception handling and PDB-based stack traces by triggering a controlled access violation.
debug.crash.warning: Intentionally causes an access violation (null pointer dereference) inside the thread pool. The crash is contained by the pool's exception handler, but this is strictly a developer tool.
debug.crash.confirm: This will deliberately trigger an access violation in a thread-pool worker to exercise the SEH handler and stack-trace generation. Continue?
debug.crash.how: A task is submitted to the ThreadPool and dereferences a null pointer. The SEH handler catches it and writes a stack trace to SkyrimNet.log; with PDB symbols available it includes function names and line numbers.
